services.boundary: Append-only audit provenance for authenticated mutations; read-only browsing does not create an audit event.
Immutable SCIP definition, reference, and hover reads at the indexed repository revision.
Permission-scoped declaration discovery and detail over published provisional contract evidence.
Pinned Buf WIRE comparison over bounded protobuf before/after source sets; no application-compatibility claim.
Deterministic receipt over the caller's already-authorized visible repository universe and published extraction state.
Immutable commit, blame, and diff reads within repository authorization.
Owner-or-grant authorization, fail-closed reads, transfer revision, and cursor invalidation.
Immutable revisions, runs, artifacts, decisions, dispositions, baselines, and watch revisions under one Investigation.
Investigation-owned artifact pins, policy precedence, and bounded retention sweeps; a Workbench adds no independent retention authority.
Permission-scoped proof bundles and deterministic impact projections over published evidence with adjacent coverage.
Recipient-scoped, offline-verifiable export whose signature proves bytes and signer, not current validity.
Permission-filtered source search over indexed repository revisions.
